mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 0.15% signals accommodative monetary policy that compresses equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.15%.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 5.5% indicates labor market weakness and economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 5.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signal broad-based consumer demand contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline from their prior 3-month levels.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) below 105.0 signals manufacturing sector slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 105.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) above its 12-month moving average signal strengthening housing market activity and economic confidence, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST is above its 12-month average.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL year-over-year growth above 2.0% signals accelerating inflation and potential monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL yoy > 2.0.

mechanism_narrative: Payrolls growth (PAYEMS) above 150k per month signals robust labor market expansion and corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS growth > 150k.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in industrial production (INDPRO) and GDP growth (GDPC1) signal economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both INDPRO and GDPC1 decline from their prior 3-month levels.
